scope: Independent original-source duration ownership with dispersed premises, typed elapsed/planned/deadline values, withheld conflicting/unreviewed candidates and safe legacy display.
embeddings: noop confined to owned QA; normal Gemini embedding configuration unchanged
duration_counts_basis: Extraction rows/options; identical original action/value targets share one assessment. Counts do not equal distinct stored events or source completeness.
qualification: Known synthetic regression cases plus source-only diagnostic probes. Not blind real-contract qualification.
remaining_limits: Eleven final source inventories remained partial despite all declared checks passing; completeness remains unestablished.
Owner assignment and duration kind remain model assessments. Located quotes and independent review do not establish semantic truth, entitlement or legal applicability.
Only proposed literals are reviewed; wholly omitted fields still depend on batch/source inventory discovery. Free effect prose, amounts, penalties and units are not comprehensively qualified.
Planned and notice-deadline kinds passed diagnostic source-only probes, not full normative contract coverage qualification.
Existing graph records are not rewritten or reanalysed; legacy durations are withheld in the normalized UI until assessed.
Real PDFs, amendments across documents, exceptions/precedence and broader contract vocabularies need independent qualification.
English synthetic project metadata still displays French; this existing metadata issue was not changed.
No new Laya/GLiNER training, MLX acceleration or architecture qualification.

release.release_delta: Model-tested duration source unchanged. Adds strict complete-analysis request validation and committed VCS build metadata.
